field_text_formatted.value: Vale ships as one binary, and it has to be on every web server and in the CLI container. drush vale:install covers Linux and macOS. On a container host, build it into every image that serves Drupal or runs Drush, as druxtjs.org does on Lagoon, and add gcompat on Alpine. Other managed hosts are on the 1.1.0 list.
